items.html:
(to the question) The thigh of Jacob
See answer 65, where it was explained that the essence of ZA is Netzah, and its HGT are from the upper ones, and Hod is from the lower ones, which is Malchut. And all the hold of the Sitra Achra can be only in Malchut, and not in ZA itself. Therefore the Sitra Achra can cling to the Hod of ZA, since it is from the inclusion of Malchut in it, and not to Netzah, which is the phase of ZA itself.
